correctness.rationale: For rational cohomology of unmarked genus-zero degree-two stable maps to P^(n-1), Kiem-Moon gives P_n(q)=(1-q^(n-1))(1-q^n)(1-q^(n+1))/((1-q)^2(1-q^2)). The source polynomial uses q=t², hence odd-degree cohomology vanishes. First differences multiply by (1-q) and use coefficients c(j)=floor(j/2)+1 for nonnegative j in 1/[(1-q)(1-q²)]. Up to relevant middle indices, d_k=c(k)-c(k-n+1)-c(k-n)-c(k-n-1); shifts of two numerator factors begin only at degree 2n-1. For n=2m+1, d_(n-1+s)=m-s; for n=2m, d_(n-1+s)=m-1-2floor(s/2). These yield plateaus of width 2 (odd n), 1 (n divisible by 4), 3 (n==2 mod4), exact claimed central positions, and peak floor(3n²/8). Palindromicity (degree 3n-4) supplies decreasing half. n=2 boundary checked, no unsupported higher-degree claim. Independent exact rational-polynomial expansions for n=2..50 verify all peaks, indices and symmetry, but proof is coefficientwise.
